284373767_8bec5901.text: The direct pathway from the lateral hypothalamus to the mouse olfactory bulb (OB) includes neurons that express the neuropeptide orexin‐A

284373767_17b115a2.text: Both orexin‐A and MCH neurons are genetically heterogeneous, with subsets that co‐express an isoform of vesicular glutamate transporter (VGLUT). We used confocal imaging to test whether the projections from orexin‐A and MCH neurons to the OB reflect this glutamatergic heterogeneity. The majority of putative orexin‐A axon terminals overlapped with VGLUT2, with smaller proportions that co‐expressed VGLUT1 or that did not overlap with either VGLUT1 or VGLUT2.
